issues.title: Broken Internal References
issues.why: The spec references 07-runner-interface.md and 06-php-known-issues.md in multiple places (AC-09, File Inventory), but these files are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Provide 07-runner-interface.md and 06-php-known-issues.md or merge their content into 02-script-reference.md.

issues.title: Acceptance Criteria Mismatch
issues.why: AC-09 and AC-10 are highly detailed, but AC-01 through AC-08 are generic boilerplate that doesn't verify the specific logic of pnpm PnP or Go/React orchestration.
issues.fix: Add functional GWT criteria for pnpm PnP store resolution and cross-drive fallback logic.

issues.title: Concurrency / Process Locking
issues.why: The script performs recursive deletions and port binding but does not address cases where files are locked by an IDE or a previous instance is still bound to the port.
issues.fix: Add a pre-flight check to kill processes bound to the configured ports before starting Step 3.
